current.text: Aldama moved from Memphis to Dallas this offseason.
He is not fully cleared after knee surgery and was set to take only partial part in camp. Yahoo lists him as questionable with a knee issue.
Dallas has a crowded frontcourt, with many forwards who fit best at power forward. That limits his minutes.
Dusty May is the new Dallas head coach. It is not yet known how he will split minutes among the centers and forwards, Aldama included.

Josh projects him as the seventh man, playing in the low 20s in minutes. The 28 minutes a night he got on a Memphis team that was not trying to win should not repeat. He needs to start and play about 28 minutes to matter.
Josh ranks him close to 200 and does not understand a Yahoo ADP of 109. He has almost no draft value.
Dallas has a 4-4-4 schedule in the fantasy playoff weeks, probably the best in the league. It also has a league-high 16 back-to-backs.

durable.text: He is close to average in most categories, with above-average rebounds.
He is a weak free throw shooter for a player who shoots, and only a middling three-point shooter. His low free throw volume limits the damage to team FT%.
He commits few turnovers for his role.
Lloyd calls him a backup-quality big man.
He had knee surgery at the end of the 2025-26 season.

note: Both Yahoo and ESPN value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 254, ESPN rank 173), and the experts see a bench role in the low 20s in minutes. With only 144 players drafted, he is not worth drafting. At most he is a 1 USD bench pick, even though our league paid 3 USD for him last season. Early in the season, check whether his knee is cleared and whether Dusty May gives him starter minutes. Dallas plays 4-4-4 in the playoff weeks, so he becomes a waiver add if injuries open up the frontcourt.
